features.title: Header fits narrow phones
features.before: The header extended past a 320px screen and its actions were small.
features.after: The logo, phone, Apply and menu fit within the screen; actions have 44px targets.

features.title: Calculator controls made for touch
features.before: Tabs were 34px tall and sliders had a narrow interaction area.
features.after: 44px tabs and slider hit areas, a single-column layout and a separate result area. Same calculations.

features.title: Application fields on a narrow screen
features.before: Progress controls were small and the narrow layout varied between fields.
features.after: Consistent field sizing, one column at phone widths and larger progress controls.

features.title: Compact topic filtering on the blog
features.before: Wrapped filter buttons pushed the first article further down.
features.after: A labelled topic selector on phones; the existing desktop filter buttons remain.

features.title: FAQ topics with larger tap areas
features.before: Topics wrapped unevenly across two narrow columns.
features.after: A single-column list with consistent spacing and larger tap targets.

features.title: Bank selection that is easier to scan
features.before: Two columns squeezed bank logos and names into small cards.
features.after: One clear bank row per line. Real bank connections remain unavailable in this build.

features.title: Long policy links stay within the page
features.before: A long URL extended beyond a 320px screen.
features.after: Long URLs wrap within the reading column; policy words and destinations are unchanged.

features.title: Footer links easier to tap
features.before: Footer links and social buttons were smaller than comfortable touch targets.
features.after: Larger touch areas and better wrapping, with the current footer design retained.

features.title: Cookie choices fit small phones
features.before: Cookie actions could feel cramped on narrow phones.
features.after: A compact two-column action area with a full-width settings button and 44px controls. Preferences are unchanged.
